dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: Could you kindly get me a metal flower?

dialogues.speaker: Richeza
dialogues.text: (I think I've seen this child before, on Moon Prayer Night...)

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: I have a friend who's really interested in metal flowers.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Columbina tells Richeza about what happened...

dialogues.speaker: Richeza
dialogues.text: Hahaha, I see. Never thought my work would catch the eye of a little bird.

dialogues.speaker: Richeza
dialogues.text: Well, take one on the house — consider it a gift from me to that wee birdie. This one's particularly small, so it should be a cinch to carry around.

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: Thank you for this, and on behalf of that little bird too.
